scope.purpose: Research how product information can be acquired from the storefronts shown in the supplied channel list.
exclusions: No scraper, API client, credential flow, or scheduled collection is implemented.
A robots.txt response is not treated as permission to collect or reuse product data.
The registry does not promise that every normalized field is available from every channel.

access_methods.affiliate_catalog_api: Read-oriented catalog API, subject to affiliate approval, credentials, usage policy, and locale coverage.
access_methods.developer_catalog_api: Read-oriented developer API, subject to application registration, OAuth or API credentials, and platform terms.
access_methods.seller_partner_api: API intended for sellers, suppliers, or approved solution partners; it is not a general public catalog export.
access_methods.partner_feed: Approved partner or dropshipping feed, normally requiring a commercial relationship.
access_methods.compliant_web_assessment: No suitable public catalog API was identified in this review. Any page collection requires separate terms, robots, rate-limit, copyright, privacy, and data-reuse review.

platforms.name: Amazon
platforms.access_requirements: Amazon Associates enrollment for each target marketplace, qualifying sales, API registration, and credentials.
catalog_scope: product images and rich content when licensed
limitations: Not an unrestricted bulk catalog export.
Creators API policy and locale-specific license terms govern storage and display.
Selling Partner API is seller-scoped and is not the default research path.

evidence.note: Official page states that Creators API provides Amazon product catalog access and lists prerequisites.

evidence.note: Documentation identifies Sellers and Service Partners as API consumers.
